title: Fork separation + fresh multi-source ingest project

questions.prompt: What should the "separation" deliverable in this repo be?
questions.description: The fork (`development`) is 528 changed files / +66k lines over upstream `main`, almost purely additive. How much restructuring should happen here vs. just documenting the boundary?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Manifest only: produce a fork-vs-upstream inventory (file/commit classification + extraction notes) under goals/fork-separation-ingest/, and leave both branches untouched.

options.label: Restructure: split fork layer into its own package/dir in this repo
Make development a clean upstream mirror; move all fork work out
Merge latest upstream main into development first, then manifest

questions.prompt: Where should the fresh project live, and what should it be called?
questions.description: The new project depends on the upstream notebooklm-py API (published on PyPI) and does its own multi-source ingestion.

questions.prompt: Which fork subsystems should be lifted into the fresh project?
questions.description: Fork-owned code, graph-traced: `_preprocessing/` (chunkers, embeddings, IngestionService), `db/` + `alembic/` (Postgres+pgvector schema), `_app/` corpus orchestration (corpus, scope, tracing, artifact_ingest), transcription/audio, fact-check/SFL/assessment, TUI, web UI, REST corpus routes, MCP clauses tools.
questions.recommendedAnswer: preprocessing-core + db-schema + corpus-orchestration (the proven ingest path); defer transcription and the UIs.

questions.prompt: Which input source types must the fresh project's ingestion v1 support?
questions.description: Upstream `client.sources` already exposes add_url / add_text / add_file / add_drive / add_drive_file + get_fulltext; audio needs artifacts.download_audio → transcribe; the fork also has a LocalAsset disk cache and note ingestion.
questions.recommendedAnswer: URL, text, file upload, and audio artifacts as the four v1 paths; Drive and notes later.

questions.prompt: What storage/embedding stack should the fresh project use?
questions.description: Upstream notebooklm-py has no embeddings API, so embeddings must be external either way. The fork already ships a proven Postgres + pgvector schema with alembic migrations and an Ollama adapter (embeddinggemma-300m).
questions.recommendedAnswer: Reuse the fork's Postgres + pgvector + Ollama stack (schema and migrations already battle-tested in the DB-pipeline goal).

options.label: SQLite for dev, Postgres for prod

questions.prompt: How should the fresh project depend on upstream notebooklm-py?
questions.description: Upstream publishes to PyPI (`notebooklm-py`, fork currently at 0.8.1); upstream main has 344 commits not yet in development.
questions.recommendedAnswer: PyPI release of notebooklm-py (clean semver upgrades; no vendoring).

options.label: Git dependency pinned to teng-lin/notebooklm-py main

questions.prompt: What is the done condition for this goal?
questions.description: What must exist (and be verifiable) to call this goal complete?
questions.recommendedAnswer: The fork/upstream manifest exists under goals/fork-separation-ingest/, and the fresh project ingests all selected v1 source types end-to-end (add → fulltext → chunk → embed → pgvector) with passing automated tests.
